# orch8_queue_dispatch (Resource)

Dispatch mode of a worker queue (`/queues/dispatch`): `poll` (workers poll) or `push` (the engine POSTs a signed envelope to `push_url`). `POST /queues/dispatch` is an upsert, so mode/URL/secret update in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Push tasks on the `gpu` queue to a serverless worker instead of polling.
resource "orch8_queue_dispatch" "gpu" {
  queue_name = "gpu"
  mode       = "push"
  push_url   = "https://workers.example.com/orch8/push"
  secret     = var.push_secret
}

variable "push_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) `poll` or `push`.
- `queue_name` (String) Queue name.

### Optional

- `push_url` (String) Public HTTPS URL for `push` mode (required when mode = push).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC secret for pushed envelopes. Write-only: never returned by the engine; removing it clears it.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant. Defaults to the provider's tenant_id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) `<tenant_id>/<queue_name>`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by "<tenant_id>/<queue_name>".
terraform import orch8_queue_dispatch.gpu acme/gpu
```
